posts.hook: openai's largest ai training run is still on hold, the same day stripe closed a $7.5b ai bet
posts.caption: openai's astra pause lifted but its biggest rl run stays frozen indefinitely, stripe closed its $7.5b buy of ai router openrouter and told investors 'the singularity' already started, a cop got caught using flock cameras 717 times to stalk his estranged wife, and meta ran ads for a nonconsensual deepfake app. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: openai's largest rl training run is still paused indefinitely
slides.desc: monitoring now eats about 20% of the inference compute it covers

terms.gloss: reinforcement learning, training a model by rewarding good outputs

slides.title: stripe closed its $7.5b acquisition of ai model router openrouter
slides.desc: a 5x jump from its valuation just three months ago

slides.title: stripe told investors january 1 marked 'the beginning of the singularity'
slides.desc: alongside h1 revenue growth of 41% year over year

slides.title: ai chip startup fractile is raising ~$600m at a $6.5b valuation
slides.desc: up from ~$1b three months ago, with a $250m anthropic supply deal already signed

slides.title: a florida cop used flock cameras 717 times to track his estranged wife
slides.desc: searches ran for nearly two years on department devices, on and off duty

slides.title: meta ran ads for an app generating nonconsensual deepfakes of real people
slides.desc: including footage resembling a sitting female us politician

slides.title: go 1.27 shipped with generic methods and post-quantum crypto
slides.desc: small allocations get up to 30% cheaper, and json unmarshaling is faster

posts.hook: rust's package registry shipped malware for 86 minutes, and that was only the day's second-worst trust problem
posts.caption: a compromised rust crate ran a remote payload on every machine that compiled it for 86 minutes, bun 1.4 shipped a runtime 64 claude agents ported from zig to rust, grok still leaks chat history to instructions hidden on a web page two months after xai was told, and a people-search site left 9 million faces in an open bucket. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: a compromised rust crate ran a remote payload on anyone who compiled it
slides.desc: arrayref has 245m downloads; the bad release was live ==86 minutes==

terms.gloss: a rust software package, like an npm module

slides.title: bun 1.4 is the first release written in rust, ported by 64 claude agents
slides.desc: 535,000 lines of zig translated in 11 days, with ==13,044 unsafe blocks==

terms.gloss: the low-level language bun was originally written in

slides.title: grok leaks your chat history to instructions hidden on a web page
slides.desc: xai was told on june 3; the attack still works today

terms.gloss: elon musk's ai company, which makes grok

slides.title: a people-search site left 9 million face photos open to anyone
slides.desc: 450gb in an unsecured bucket, reachable from the site's own code

slides.title: meta is now one of microsoft's biggest ai customers
slides.desc: hundreds of millions a year, trillions of tokens weekly via azure

slides.title: waymo built its own chip to cut its reliance on nvidia
slides.desc: a custom asic meant to sharpen its robotaxis' reflexes

terms.gloss: a chip built for a single job, not general computing

slides.title: every tracked tesla robotaxi ride in austin now runs with no safety monitor
slides.desc: 170 rides across 54 cars over two weeks, per a crowdsourced tracker
